title: ge16.evidence.v1
description: Immutable observation row. Never edited after write; corrections are new rows with supersedes. IDs are deterministic (normalize_link.v1 + sha256) so re-import adds no rows.

payload.description: Original source fields, verbatim. No importer rewriting.

file.description: Repository-relative path of the artifact the row was read from.

offset.description: Optional positional index of the row inside the source file.

collected_at.description: Source-file collection/commit clock (envelope field). May be empty when the source records none.

source_recovery.description: Owner-ruled liveness probe for evidence whose only judgment provenance is an orphaned backfill flag (P2.2 brief decision 2). Real HTTP results only.
